An established key parks 2,190 unsellable POA, idle 19 epochs, from its basalt reserve as one hollow on a public atlas — a sealed voucher for one recruit and funding path. A second hollow from that path is dropped. A missed 38-byte ping due in 31s, a reused sign, or a shared payer moves 710 POA to a random auditor and benches both keys 15 epochs. One backer idles 2,190 POA; 380 recruits freeze 832,200 POA across 380 reserves, vs ~150 POA reward. Backer mills: cap three live hollows per two-hop cluster and slash shared-payer or 3ms-lockstep pairs.
